images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE far background plane for the existing side-view fighting game Digital Circus — Encore. Deliver one opaque 16:9 landscape PNG, preferably 1672 x 941, not a contact sheet.
Primary request: an empty neon bar inspired by the officially published bar scene in The Amazing Digital Circus episode 5, recomposed as a wide readable fighting-game backdrop.
Reference images: Image 1 is a YouTube storyboard sheet; use ONLY its bottom-left frame (the wide bar view). Image 2 is another storyboard sheet; use ONLY its top-middle frame (frontal bar). Image 3 provides shelving and lighting detail in its top-middle and center frames. The sheets are visual references, NOT an output layout. Ignore all other locations and ALL characters.
Composition: level frontal side-view, broad dark interior. Black and charcoal wall panels and recessed bottle/glass shelving with restrained pale teal shelf lighting; a few ceiling-hung segmented frosted-glass dome pendant lights. Colored neon motifs remain restrained: pink cocktail-glass outline, yellow balloon-dog outline, small green geometric neon glow. The broad front countertop will be a separate middle plane, so omit any large foreground counter, tables or stools from THIS layer. Keep the lower 31% of the image a quiet opaque near-black base with no checker tiles; the floor will be added as another layer. Architectural masses and neon accents stay above that area.
Style: polished stylized 3D animation background, crisp readable large forms, subtle material texture, soft moody local light. Not a photoreal nightclub and not pixel art. Dark desaturated charcoal/teal interior with small pink, yellow and green luminous accents, as observed in the reference.
Constraints: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, faces, audience, hands, weapons, interface, border, montage, or text. No curtain stage, cave rocks, grand piano or red/yellow fast-food menus. Do not imitate the unrelated Little Daisy jazz club. No new canon facts are implied: the horizontal layout is an original game adaptation.
Output: one continuous clean FAR plane, fully opaque to every edge, 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE MID parallax plane, a full-frame transparent PNG for a 16:9 side-view fighting game, 1672 x 941.
Primary request: draw ONLY the dark bar counter and the black-and-white checker tile floor belonging to the episode-5 neon bar.
Reference images: Image 1 is the accepted FAR plane already produced: use it only to align the viewpoint, palette and horizontal architecture. DO NOT reproduce its walls, shelves, lamps or neon signs. Image 2 is an official storyboard sheet: ONLY its bottom-left frame shows the relevant wide bar/floor. Image 3: ONLY the top-middle frame shows the relevant frontal bar. Ignore every character and every unrelated scene.
Precise composition of THIS alpha layer: upper approximately 53% of the canvas is completely transparent. A slim long charcoal countertop with a pale teal luminous front rim runs horizontally from edge to edge around 55% of image height, behind the future fighters. A shallow dark paneled counter front ends around 68% of image height. Below it, a muted charcoal and warm-gray checker-tile floor recedes in perspective, filling the entire lower 32% of the canvas down to every bottom/side edge. The playable standing line will lie at 79% of image height and must be on a continuous unobstructed floor. The chessboard geometry is floor material, NOT a transparency preview grid. Make it polished but subdued, with sparse teal/pink/yellow reflections, avoiding extreme white tiles.
Style: clean stylized 3D animation, matching the accepted far plane. Level frontal camera. No camera tilt or central corridor. Empty clear combat lane.
Transparency: real native alpha, fully transparent above and around the countertop, no opaque background and no fake transparency pattern. The countertop/facade/floor themselves are opaque enough to cover the black lower base of the far plane. Preserve the full intended transparent margin; do not crop around the objects.
Avoid: walls, shelving, ceiling, pendant lamps, neon signs, people, characters, faces, hands, bottles on the counter, chairs or stools blocking the floor, weapons, text, UI, border, split panels or contact sheets.
Output: one full 16:9 MID-plane RGBA image, not a composite with the far layer.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE NEAR foreground parallax plane for a 16:9 side-view fighting game, full-frame 1672 x 941 transparent PNG.
Primary request: only a few extremely subtle soft neon reflections in the lowest corners of a dark polished floor, matching the supplied empty neon-bar layers.
Reference images: Image 1 is the completed FAR background and image 2 the completed MID counter/floor. They are alignment and palette references only. Do not reproduce any opaque part of them; this new image is ONLY sparse foreground light on alpha.
Composition: the upper 84% of the canvas and the broad central combat area remain entirely transparent. Place a low diffuse desaturated teal reflection near the bottom-left edge; small faint magenta and amber reflection slivers near the bottom-right edge, aligned with the corresponding pink/yellow lights. Each mark is low, wide and soft, broken like reflected light on a polished tiled floor, without drawing the floor tiles themselves. Keep all visible marks below the standing line (79% image height). The center must be clear.
Style: restrained stylized 3D reflected light with native partial transparency, matching the soft neon palette. Very low opacity; these are secondary accents, not bright light beams or scene objects.
Constraints: no floor plane, no checker tiles, no wall, counter, bottles, lamps, characters, furniture, solid shapes, text, border, contact sheet, black background, white background, or transparency checkerboard. Real transparent background, including all blank areas. Do not crop the transparent margin. Do not add streaks across the middle of the combat lane.
Output: one subtle NEAR-plane RGBA image, full 16:9 canvas; not a composite scene.
